config._purpose: EXPLORATORY. Design brief, direction A: the mechanism of VISION claim 4 the right way round, in the published family, with no new knob. Above lambda = 1 the flat sheet is the lowest state; a tube (one side curled to length 4, so one large dimension in place of two) lies 4 (lambda - 1) = 1 per vertex above it (test_sheet_tube_cube_ladder). Start from a perfect tube (a 16 x 4 or 24 x 4 torus) at several couplings and record the energy per vertex: does the tube hold, when does it give way, does it become a flat sheet (phi = 1, no surplus, one piece), and does the energy given off match the exact number? Fixed temperature. Couplings from a one-replica scratch pilot; not pre-registered.
